name: Warmup-plateau-power-cosine
tagline: Linear warmup, then constant plateau, then a power-cosine decay; warmup, plateau length, and power adapt to architecture and dataset.
formula: $$\eta(e) = \begin{cases} \eta_{\min} + (\eta_0-\eta_{\min})\,\frac{e+1}{W}, & e < W \\ \eta_0, & W \le e < P \\ \eta_{\min} + (\eta_0-\eta_{\min})\,\tfrac{1}{2}\left(1+\cos\!\big(\pi\,t^{\rho}\big)\right), & e \ge P \end{cases},\quad t = \tfrac{e-P}{T-1-P},\;\eta_{\min}=5\!\times\!10^{-4}\,\eta_0$$
init_recovers: warmup_cosine baseline when plateau=0 and power=1
diff_from_baseline: Splits the cosine baseline into a three-phase shape (warmup -> plateau -> power-cosine), inserting a constant-LR exploration plateau and replacing standard cosine with cos(pi t^rho), with separate hyperparameters for ResNet56/CIFAR-100 vs. shallower nets.

name: Adaptive plateau cosine
tagline: Linear warmup, hold at base_lr, then cosine decay to base_lr/100; warmup and plateau lengths chosen per architecture and dataset.
formula: $$\eta(e) = \begin{cases} \eta_0\,\tfrac{e+1}{W}, & e < W \\ \eta_0, & W \le e < W+P \\ \eta_f + \tfrac{1}{2}(\eta_0-\eta_f)\big(1+\cos\pi\,\tfrac{e-W-P}{T-W-P}\big), & e \ge W+P \end{cases},\;\eta_f = \eta_0/100$$
diff_from_baseline: Adds an explicit per-arch/per-dataset plateau between warmup and cosine decay (extending warmup_cosine), enforces at least 10 cosine-decay epochs, and decays only down to base_lr/100 instead of zero.

name: Architecture-aware OneCycle
tagline: Cosine warmup to a peak above base_lr, cosine decay back down, then a linear cooldown to a near-zero floor; phase fractions and peak depend on architecture.
formula: $$\eta(e) = \begin{cases} \eta_i + \tfrac{1}{2}(\eta_p-\eta_i)(1-\cos\pi\,\tfrac{e}{W}), & e < W \\ \eta_m + \tfrac{1}{2}(\eta_p-\eta_m)(1+\cos\pi\,\tfrac{e-W}{D}), & W\le e<W+D \\ \eta_m - (\eta_m-\eta_f)\,\tfrac{e-W-D}{C}, & e \ge W+D \end{cases}$$
init_recovers: OneCycle baseline when max_lr_mult=1 and pct_cooldown=0
diff_from_baseline: Generalizes one_cycle: cosine (not cosine-from-zero) warmup that overshoots base_lr by 1.5-2x, then cosine decay, then an additional linear cooldown to base_lr*1e-4 instead of base_lr/25.

name: Tri-phase cosine + late rebound
tagline: Linear warmup, slightly-decreasing 'hold' band, then power-cosine decay to a non-zero floor with a small sinusoidal rebound in the last 15% of training.
formula: $$\eta(p) = \begin{cases} 0.2\eta_0 + 0.8\eta_0\,\tfrac{p}{W}, & p<W \\ \eta_0\!\left(1-0.06\big(1-\cos\pi\tfrac{p-W}{H-W}\big)\right), & W\le p<H \\ \eta_0\!\left(\phi + (1-\phi)\cdot\tfrac{1+\cos(\pi t^{\rho})}{2} + \mathbf{1}_{t>0.85}\,r\,\phi\,\sin^2\!\big(\pi\,\tfrac{t-0.85}{0.15}\big)\right), & p\ge H \end{cases},\;t = \tfrac{p-H}{1-H}$$
init_recovers: warmup + cosine baseline when phi=0, rho=1, r=0 and hold band is removed
diff_from_baseline: Generalizes warmup_cosine with a slightly-decaying 'hold' phase, a power-cosine envelope (cos(pi t^rho)) that lands on a non-zero floor phi*base_lr, and adds a late sin^2 rebound in the last 15% of training.

name: Cosine warmup + hold + cosine decay
tagline: Per-architecture three-phase schedule: cosine ramp-up (or short linear), constant base_lr hold, then plain cosine decay to a small floor.
formula: $$\eta(e) = \begin{cases} \eta_{\min} + (\eta_0-\eta_{\min})\,\tfrac{1-\cos(\pi (e+1)/W)}{2}, & e < W \\ \eta_0, & W \le e < W+H \\ \eta_{\min} + (\eta_0-\eta_{\min})\,\tfrac{1+\cos(\pi (e-W-H)/D)}{2}, & e \ge W+H \end{cases}$$
init_recovers: cosine baseline when W=0 and H=0
diff_from_baseline: Adds an architecture-specific cosine (or fixed-epoch linear) warmup and a constant-LR hold phase ahead of the plain cosine decay used in the cosine baseline; floor is set per-arch instead of zero.
